text: A reader who attends to what is missing will find a good deal here. Sarah is absent from the whole chapter, and her death is recorded in the very next verse; the narrator never says that something in the household failed to survive the mountain, yet the order of events leaves little doubt of it, and the reader is left to draw the inference alone. The narrator moves on where a lesser storyteller would linger. Abraham returns to the servants. Isaac is not mentioned.
